latestVersion.changelog:
Audio Editor Online 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches an easy-to-use, cloud-powered audio editing tool for podcasters, YouTubers, and content creators.
- Users can upload audio/video files (up to 500MB) and describe desired edits (e.g., noise removal, silence trimming, sync audio to video).
- Automatic cloud setup: Anonymous token and session created on first use, with 100 free credits for new users.
- Supports rapid export to various formats including MP4, MP3, WAV, and more.
- Includes error handling for token/session issues, file limits, and credits.
- Provides clear workflows and feedback throughout upload, edit, and export processes.
